title: Implement append-only TimelineEvent writer, taxonomy, and idempotency rules
verify: TimelineEvent lines are appended only after authoritative source records exist or in the same logical command boundary.
Duplicate and out-of-order events cannot overwrite PostgreSQL/read-model state.
evidence_required: Append-only timeline tests covering duplicate source refs and event ids.
Redaction tests proving timeline payloads exclude secrets/auth material and raw UI/model/chat data.
constraints: Existing timeline lines are never edited, deleted, reordered, or rewritten.
Timeline import/replay is audit/export/debug only and never normal runtime mutation.
invariants: `timeline.jsonl` remains append-only audit/export, not primary mutable state.
Redaction happens before logs, timeline, manifests, Bus, UI Feed, screenshots, exports, or agent context.
verification_targets: Append-only timeline and no timeline replay authority.
